policy: All frozen SIMBAD stellar entries within 3000 ly with compiled Johnson V < 2.70, deduplicating the Alpha Centauri system in favor of A/B components; Acrux uses the Bright Star Catalogue combined V=0.76. Includes Sun as the map origin.
selectionReview: The V=2.42-2.69 expansion was queried through SIMBAD TAP on 2026-09-30. The SIMBAD stellar hierarchy filter excludes NGC 1980, whose integrated V=2.50 is not a stellar entry.

radius_solar.caveat: Nominal solar radius is an exact conversion constant, 695700 km; not an uncertainty-free measurement of the variable physical Sun.

metallicity_dex.caveat: The present Sun is the zero point of this logarithmic solar-relative abundance scale. Zero dex does not imply zero metals and is not the protosolar heavy-element mass fraction.

age_gyr.caveat: Rounded approximate age since formation; no fabricated uncertainty or extra precision is adopted.

mass_solar.caveat: Unity as the reference for solar-relative mass; not an independent mass measurement.

luminosity_solar.caveat: Unity as the reference for solar-relative luminosity; nominal solar luminosity is 3.828e26 W (IAU 2015 B3).

absolute_mag.caveat: Johnson V absolute visual magnitude, not bolometric magnitude.
